name: CowsSMP
description:
🐄 The Moo-st Vanilla Survival Server

Pure vanilla survival Minecraft — no mods, no plugins, no udder nonsense. Just you, your pickaxe, creepers... and cows from every era of Minecraft history grazing in the same world.

What makes us special:

- ✅ 100% Vanilla Survival — as Notch intended

- ✅ FULL CROSSPLAY — Java, Beta, and Bedrock players share one world

- ✅ Extreme Version Support — Beta 1.7.3 to latest (26.x), Combat Test, even April Fools versions

- ✅ Live Dynmap — track players and explore the world in real-time at cows.info.gf:8123

One rule: No lag machines (keep it smooth for the herd!)

World created March 2026. The first cow has already claimed a hill.

Grab your bucket — or your version from any era — and come milk some adventures with us, cowpokes.
